changelog: Preserve mirrored project metadata badge blocks for bilingual README pairs.
summary: Keeps English Markdown and Chinese Markdown pairs in structural and topical sync, with reciprocal language links at the top of each file. Use when the user edits or mentions README.md and README-zh.md/README-en.md, any *-zh.md or *-en.md with a sibling *.md, bilingual docs, 中英文同步, language switch links, or translating between zh/en markdown files.
